title: Harden metadata, extents, and integrity
runtime_identity: Linux 6.18.44 x86_64, 2 vCPU, Node v22.22.2, Chromium 1194; loopback only
decision_or_code_delta: ram/descriptor.js: Extents, generations, epoch and plan identity checked on every operation.
expected: Invalid metadata is rejected before memory access or command side effects, and checksums never replace authorization.
memory_scope: gateway process (+ worker threads) and worker processes
residual_risks: self-reviewed by the implementer; no independent verification
rollback: delete ram/, gateway/worker-link.js, worker/core.js, worker/thread.js; restore the v1 files from hermit-vws 1.1.0-vws.1 (hashes in ledger/ramws_source.json)
linked_tests: Ownership/Validity: another principal, another session, stale epoch, stale plan (policy revoked), stale or foreign lease are all REJECTED with a reason
Validity: stale generation and foreign handles are refused and counted
